parties.party_name: Christian and Democratic Union – Czechoslovak People's Party

note: Corrected vs. prior version: a per-party breakdown of the SPOLU alliance's 52 combined seats IS available from good sources (Wikipedia's own results table, and Denik.cz's dedicated SPOLU results page) - ODS 27, KDU-ČSL 16, TOP 09 9 (27+16+9=52) - so, consistent with how Czechia_2021.json handles SPOLU/PirStan, the three constituent parties are broken out individually here rather than left as one combined row with a null wikidata_id. Babiš III government (ANO + SPD + Motorists/AUTO) formally nominated 9 December 2025 after a coalition agreement signed 3 November 2025; SPOLU's three parties, STAN and the Pirates are all in opposition. Seats sum to 200/200.
